title: AI front desk for clinics — 30 s explainer
assumptions: Example project: figures and brand are placeholders
audience: Clinic owners and practice managers in India
takeaway: An AI receptionist answers every call so staff can focus on patients in the room.

look.visual_style: cinematic live-action, naturalistic, shallow depth of field
look.lighting: soft daylight from large windows on the left; cooler and harsher in the 'problem' half, warmer in the 'solution' half
look.camera_language: locked-off close-ups for tension, slow dolly-ins for the turn, eye-level medium shots
reference_frames: Close-up of a ringing desk phone, blinking red line light, empty chair out of focus
Medium shot of a receptionist between a patient and a ringing phone, papers in hand
Warm slow push-in on the same receptionist smiling at a patient at the counter

CHAR_RECEPTIONIST.descriptor: a woman in her late 20s with a low bun, a teal clinic polo shirt and a lanyard ID badge

LOC_RECEPTION.descriptor: a bright, modern Indian clinic reception with a white counter, a desk phone, potted plants and a small waiting area behind

strategy.a_roll_purpose: Show the human moment at the front desk — before and after

audio.music: minimal piano turning into light upbeat pulse at the turn, ~100 BPM

do: Keep one clear subject per shot
Keep lighting direction from the left
dont: Real brand logos in generated footage
